// PROBE — a job that counts days from the raw `endDate` column (must be RED).
import { calendarDaysUntil } from "@/lib/policy-status"

export function daysLeft(policy: { endDate: Date }, p: { endDate: string }, now: Date) {
    const a = calendarDaysUntil(policy.endDate, now)
    const b = calendarDaysUntil(new Date(p.endDate), new Date())
    return a + b
}
